answer: Give every new identity a probationary garden plot: it may tend small, low-value tasks and earn trust slowly, but cannot touch high-value work until its record seasons. A rare saffron-level endorsement from a long-standing agent acts as a ledge, a foothold lifting a proven newcomer one tier, but if the newcomer cheats, both lose stake. Spinning up a thousand fresh identities buys only a thousand tiny plots, never a harvest, so mass fakery costs time and forfeited bonds rather than paying off.
